connector.name: Skipodds
connector.registryDescription: Fair sports win probabilities - bookmaker consensus, de-vigged to sum to 100%. 13 sports, 69+ books.
connector.summary: Hosted at skipodds.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.skipodds, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api-key>. Optional - without it the shared demo quota applies (100 requests/day). Free and paid keys at https://skipodds.com
